trust_decision.summary: The savegame loader trusts the file's per-city wl_length and uses it, unchecked, as the loop bound for writes into the fixed 64-entry worklist entries[] array in worklist_load() (savegame2.c and savegame3.c). The fix adds an upper clamp to MAX_LEN_WORKLIST there, plus a log-only check on wl_max_length.

landing_point.why: The summary names worklist_load(), and savegame3.c is the current-format loader (savemain.c:65-68), so a reader of the summary searches for that function and lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: server 'load' command / -f savefile (load_command, server/stdinhand.c:3795, calls savegame_load at server/stdinhand.c:3909) -> savegame3_load for +version3 saves
same as above; sg_load_player_cities reads player%d.wl_max_length
same as above; legacy sg_load_player_cities reads wl_max_length

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: server/savegame/savegame2.c:804 (2.3-2.6 format loader, selected at server/savegame/savemain.c:69-72)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: savegame2.c loads only legacy 2.3-2.6 saves, so a solver could argue it's deprecated compatibility code, and that a negative wl_length can't overflow because the load loop never runs for it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A legitimate worklist with exactly MAX_LEN_WORKLIST (64) entries must still load in full. A clamp written as >= or as MAX_LEN_WORKLIST-1 (the GUI editors use that bound) would cut it short. Saves with wl_length > wl_max_length, or with wl_max_length=0 as in the shipped scenarios, must keep loading rather than fail the whole load. In the published fix that case is only logged.

O6_input_shapes: MAX_LEN_WORKLIST >= wl_length > wl_max_length (logged only, fix.diff:601-604, fix.diff:631-634)
player wl_max_length > MAX_LEN_WORKLIST (logged only, fix.diff:612-615, fix.diff:642-645)

O7_producer.where: server/savegame/savecompat.c:2348-2374 (compat upgrade builds player%d.wl_max_length from the per-city wl_length values in the file); server/savegame/savegame3.c:5598-5622 (normal save writes wl_max_length)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A negative wl_length passes the fix's '>' checks and is stored in pwl->length. Later, package_city calls worklist_copy, which passes sizeof(entry) * negative length to memcpy into the packet worklist.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The load loop never runs for a negative length, and worklist_length() asserts the range (common/worklist.c:59). So a solver who only checks the loading loop sees no write and treats the negative case as harmless.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: the sink is in common/worklist.c, reached through server/citytools.c, outside the savegame directory where the report points

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The same negative wl_length shape reaches worklist_copy through the legacy savegame2 loader.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It's the legacy 2.x format loader, and the loop again doesn't run for a negative length.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: the legacy loader sits in the same directory as the landing point; the sink is in common/

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The rally-point orders loader takes its length from the file (rally_point_length). A planted copy into a fixed-size order array would mirror the worklist bug.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It follows the same length-from-file loading pattern a few hundred lines further on in the same function.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Make the padding loop bounded by wl_max_length write entries instead of only looking them up. The fix only logs wl_max_length > MAX_LEN_WORKLIST, so that write would overflow.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The padding loop already iterates up to the file-controlled wl_max_length, and the published fix deliberately doesn't clamp it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The client's global worklist loader reads wl_length and applies only MIN(length, MAX_LEN_WORKLIST), with no lower bound below the -1 sentinel.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It's a second implementation of the worklist-from-secfile loader in another package, so the same mistake would be plausible there.

O9_family: memory-safety: heap buffer overflow from an unchecked length read from a deserialized file (CWE-122)

O10_build.toolchain: meson+ninja (also autotools configure.ac); a server-only build is possible
O10_build.project_tests: None for the savegame load path. tests/ holds only ruleset and lint shell scripts (tests/rulesets_save.sh.in, tests/rulesets_not_broken.sh.in). Behavioural tests would have to load a crafted .sav through the freeciv-server binary.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Clamp wl_length to MAX_LEN_WORKLIST in savegame3.c worklist_load only, with an upper bound and no lower bound, and skip the legacy savegame2.c copy.

out_of_scope_notes: The same 3.2.6 release also fixed an out-of-bounds read in the unit activities.order[] savegame load (commit ef0c76c2, RM #2162, fix.diff:34-44). That commit isn't in this advisory's fix_commits.
